name: Skill Switch
description: Switch active skill for the current session and clean up tool call history

injection.description: Config namespace for skill prompt injection policy.

lowPrioritySkills.description: Skill ids injected as low-priority available skill directory entries instead of high-priority preferred skills.

videoToPrompt.description: Config namespace for the video-to-prompt module (ffmpeg recording, prompt analysis, and vtp-recording persistence).

maxRecordingSeconds.description: User-facing recording cap in seconds (default 120). Auto-stop watchdog fires at this exact value.

maxRecordingGraceSeconds.description: Extra seconds beyond maxRecordingSeconds for ffmpeg hard cap (default 10). ffmpeg -t = maxRecordingSeconds + this value.

maxRecordingSizeMB.description: Hard cap on final video file size (MB) after stop. If exceeded, recording is patched to status=failed with error='oversize'. Default 300MB ≈ 20 min at 1920x1080 / 15fps / CRF28.

framerate.description: Recording framerate, integer in [1, 60] (default 15). Runtime clamps non-finite / out-of-range values to default.

skillScriptPath.description: Absolute path to the video-to-prompt skill's video-to-prompt.sh. Default: located via skill-discovery, falling back to <HOME>/.agents/skills/video-to-prompt/scripts/video-to-prompt.sh when not discovered. Must reside under a discovered skill root or <HOME>/.agents/skills (allowlist); if you point it elsewhere it will be refused.

vtpHome.description: Root directory for VTP config + run artifacts (mirrors ~/.cua layout). Default: $HOME/.vtp. Also overridable via VTP_HOME env.

recordingRetentionDays.description: Recording directory retention in days. A recording's whole runs/<id>/ directory (events.jsonl, prompt.json, meta.json, video.mp4, reference/) and its state entry are pruned once endedAt is older than this. Does NOT govern /var/log diagnostic logs — those have an independent 2GB + 14-day cap in logger.ts.

maxReferenceCount.description: LRU cap for vtp-recording/reference/ entries. When saveAsSkill would push the count past this, the oldest non-pinned entries are removed.

vtpRecordingRoot.description: Workspace-relative directory hosting the vtp-recording skill bundle. saveAsSkill auto-generates a top-level SKILL.md here on first write.

relayTimeoutSeconds.description: 二期 F-A：saveVideoToMount 中继任务超时（秒）。挂载点 TOS 走内网传输很快,5min 视频高码率约 1-2 GB 内网 10-20s 完成;default 600s 留 safety margin 应对网络抖动。一期硬编码 30s 已拉宽。

skillIndexRebuildIntervalHours.description: 二期 F-B：skill-index-scheduler 周期任务间隔（小时）。0 = 关周期任务（仅启动 self-heal）

otelEndpoint.description: OTLP collector base endpoint for VTP observability — serves both traces and metrics (no /v1/* suffix; the SDK appends signal paths). Config-driven, mirrors CUA's single config.otel.endpoint. The plugin initializes OTel with it and propagates it (via OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT) to the spawned runtime SEA. Default http://localhost:4318.
